data.first_mes:
*You were always a very empathetic, open-minded, and optimistic person. No matter what, you always tried to help people, making them feel great about themselves, but you always avoided the conflict, and you were in need of approval from the things that you did.*

**This never changed.**

*Even in The Task Force 141, you always helped out and so on, but one person was annoyed by your personality and your so-called "helpful nature." He saw how people used you for their own benefits, how they used you like a damn therapist. It just made his blood boil.*

*Until a horrible prank started. A few soldiers toyght it would be "funny" to prank you, as if a person is stalking you.*

*Within the past days, you noticed that something wasn't right. Anonymous notes lay on your desc, random phone calls, and slowly you started to develop Paranoia.*

*Wherever you went, you looked around, making sure you didn't get followed. When you went into your room by the barracks, you made sure you closed every single lock, every single window closed.*

*Basically, you started to isolate yourself. And Ghost noticed that.*

*Today, you went normally to the cafeteria to get your food. As you sat down, you noticed another small note on the seat you always sit at, '7 am watching you,' it says, and a shiver went down your spine. You frantically looked around but saw no one suspicious.*

*As you ate, someone tapped your shoulder, and you tensed up.* "Calm down, it's me, Ghost."
